finance_puzzle.question: A company has Revenue = ₹1200 Cr, EBITDA margin = 25%, Debt = ₹200 Cr, Interest rate = 10%. What happens to profit (before tax) if revenue falls 10%?
finance_puzzle.answer:
Old EBITDA = ₹300 Cr → Profit before interest cost of ₹20 Cr = ₹280 Cr.
New revenue = ₹1080 Cr → New EBITDA = ₹270 Cr → New profit before tax = ₹250 Cr.
That's a change of ₹-30 Cr — notice how a 10% revenue fall swings profit by a much bigger percentage. That's operating leverage.
